cohort: 150 children with DDH, aged 3-5 years old, with average age of 7.5, 55.33% male and 44.67% female, treated at Liaquat National Hospital and Medical College Karachi between January 2023 and January 2024.
finding: Oligohydramnios, breech presentation, and premature birth were the most common risk factors for developmental dysplasia of the hip in children.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the delivery mode for 74% of the children with DDH.
